# Upstream source notices

`vllm-Apache-2.0.txt` is an unchanged copy of the LICENSE in the vLLM 0.10.2
source used by these experiments. It accompanies the archived vLLM source
snapshots and patches. Their original source headers are preserved. The
experiment-specific changes are identified by the R1 runtime patch and R1R
backend commitments; the frozen source files record their exact SHA256 values.

This notice identifies the upstream files and does not assign a license to
unrelated research data or other project components.
